svg.title: A child with a murmur, chest pain or palpitations: history and exam separate the benign from the cardiac cause; an innocent murmur from a pathologic one, musculoskeletal from cardiac chest pain, and sinus tachycardia from supraventricular tachycardia, which is caught by an ECG during symptoms

svg.text: A child with a MURMUR, CHEST PAIN or PALPITATIONS: BENIGN, or the HEART?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: infants: work of breathing with feeds, sweating with feeds, poor growth, cyanosis · older: syncope, exercise intolerance

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: exam: perfusion, heaves or thrills, radial vs femoral pulses, extra sounds, liver size
